regime.label: Restrictive Tightening — real rates rising
drivers: Short real rate +0.48% (decisively positive, beyond ±0.25%) — policy is above inflation
Long real yield RISING +0.68pp over 3 months (threshold +0.20pp)
Dollar +2.4% over ~1 month — firm, so higher yields ARE attracting capital (ordinary tightening, not a credibility repricing)
HY OAS 3.10% — credit calm; tightening has not broken anything yet
